_comment: Every gate of the how-to checker, seen red. Each case edits base.json (a valid how-to that uses every field schemas/how_to.toml lists) and names the code the checker must answer with. BOTH checkers run every case: src/how_to/tests.rs (the Rust checker, `just test-lib how_to`) and scripts/build-how-to.js --check (the JavaScript one, in `just lints` and `just validate-data`). A code with no case here fails both, so a new gate cannot arrive without its red. Edits: `set` puts a value at a JSON pointer (`/steps/1/short`; `/steps/-` appends), `delete` removes one, `fill` puts a string of that many letters, `hash` puts the document's own current hash at the pointer. `file` is where the checker is told the file sits (default household/fixture_base.json); `raw` replaces the whole file with text. `passes` lists edits that must leave no refusal: the gates must not fire on what is allowed.
